question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An instrument for viewing distant objects in space.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"telescope"** means an instrument designed for viewing distant objects, especially in space. (दूरबीन) • **Example: **Galileo used a telescope to observe the moons of Jupiter. • **"Telescope"** allows astronomers to see far-away celestial bodies like stars, planets, and galaxies. (दूरबीन) • **Example: **The Hubble Space Telescope has provided some of the most detailed images of the universe. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Microscope** (सूक्ष्मदर्शी): An instrument used for viewing very small objects, such as cells, that are not visible to the naked eye. • **Example:** The scientist used a microscope to examine the bacteria. • **Spectrograph** (स्पेक्ट्रोग्राफ): An instrument that separates light into a frequency spectrum and records the signal using a camera. • **Example: **The spectrograph was used to analyze the light from the distant star. • **Binoculars** (दूरबीन): An optical instrument with a lens for each eye, used for viewing distant objects. • **Example:** We used binoculars to watch the birds from afar. 179:Tff0,
